title: Remote IT and Cybersecurity Tutoring
headline: Get focused, one-on-one help with IT and cybersecurity topics.
description: Live online tutoring for IT, cybersecurity, Linux, networking, programming, labs, and technical projects. No Remote Support Plan is required.
metaTitle: Online IT and Cybersecurity Tutoring | Defend I.T. Solutions
metaDescription: Get one-on-one online tutoring for IT, cybersecurity, Linux, networking, programming, labs, certifications, and technical projects.

sections.heading: Did You Know?
paragraph: Immediate feedback can help identify a misunderstanding before it becomes a larger problem.
Hands-on practice connects technical concepts to the commands, tools, and systems that use them.
A focused session can address one class topic, lab problem, project, or skill gap without requiring a full course.

sections.heading: Who This Helps
paragraph: This service is for students, career changers, and self-directed learners who want help with a specific IT or cybersecurity topic.
It works well for classes, certification topics, labs, projects, interviews, and technical skills that benefit from live guidance.
For beginner help with everyday technology, choose [One-on-One Remote Tech Training](/services/remote/remote-training).

sections.heading: What We Teach
items: Cybersecurity concepts, system hardening, and threat modeling
Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, and C programming
Linux, networking, virtualization, and home labs
Privacy, digital safety, and related technical topics

sections.heading: How Sessions Work
paragraph: Bring a topic, question, lab, or project. We use the session to work through that goal and explain the underlying concepts.
Tutoring is guided instruction, not managed technical support or completion of graded work on your behalf.
Sessions are available online across the United States and do not require the Remote Support Plan.

faq.question: Do I need the Remote Support Plan for tutoring?
faq.answer: No. Remote tutoring is booked separately and is available online across the United States.

faq.question: What topics can we cover?
faq.answer: Sessions can cover IT fundamentals, cybersecurity, Linux, networking, programming, virtualization, home labs, certifications, and technical projects within the available expertise.

faq.question: Is tutoring only for advanced learners?
faq.answer: No. Sessions are adjusted to your current knowledge and the specific goal you bring.
